北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -6℃，注意保暖防寒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cold and clear, feels like -6℃. Remember to stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，微风不燥，早晚温差大，注意添衣。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a light breeze. Mind the temperature changes, dress accordingly.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，体感 6℃，微凉舒适，早晚加件衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear and feels like 6℃. A bit cool, add a layer in the morning/evening.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗，湿度大。体感 12℃ 舒适，别忘多喝水。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is clear and humid, feels 12℃ comfortable. Don't forget to hydrate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雾，注意交通安全。体感 17℃ 暖和哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy, drive safe. It feels a warm 17℃!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，风力 4级 体感 5℃。风大注意保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with 4-level winds, feels like 5℃. It's windy, keep warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，风力 4级 体感 2℃。风大，注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear with 4-level winds, feels like 2℃. Windy, stay warm and protected.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%。早晚微凉，出门带伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity. Slightly cool in morning/evening, bring an umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，注意防护。体感 10℃，记得多喝水。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, take precautions. Feels 10℃, remember to drink water.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 3℃，有些冷哦，记得多穿点。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels like 3℃, quite cold. Remember to layer up.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，湿度 95%。体感 9℃，注意出行安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy with 95% humidity. Feels 9℃, stay safe while out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -25℃！超级冷，注意极限保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear, feels like -25℃! Extremely cold, ensure maximum warmth.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -15℃。注意防寒，小心地滑哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and cold, feels like -15℃. Keep warm, watch for icy patches.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 9℃ 舒适。紫外线强，注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear and feels a comfortable 9℃. Strong UV, remember sun protection.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，风力 6级！体感 7℃，大风降温，多穿点。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is clear with 6-level winds! Feels like 7℃, strong winds make it colder, layer up.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴冷，体感 0℃。注意防寒保暖，别感冒啦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is clear and cold, feels like 0℃. Keep warm and avoid catching a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -12℃。寒风刺骨，务必多穿哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -12℃. The wind is biting, bundle up!
